rca of the issue: Prior: /app/backend/.env missing → MONGO_URL KeyError caused backend crash-loop → ingress returned 502 for every /api call → frontend caught fetch failure as 'Failed to fetch'. Fix: restored backend/.env (MONGO_URL + DB_NAME=azoapp_database), reinstalled web_panel node_modules, seed() rebuilt admin+demo data; Customer package label fixed to app.azoapp.homeservice. Verified end-to-end via UI + network traces.
